connector_families.interface: touch-safe keyed four-pole plug with retained strain relief
connector_families.keying: main and emergency feeds use mechanically incompatible keys
connector_families.service: 24 V/48 V main and emergency lighting

connector_families.interface: keyed twelve-position plug family with blanking cap and fixed body-side bracket
connector_families.keying: different voltage/data duties use unique shell keys and labels
connector_families.service: door, PIS, CCTV and local low-voltage/data services

door_interface.boundary: complete certified supplier cassette including leaf, operator, lock, seals and controller
door_interface.osr_interface: four adjustable carrier shoes, two datum pins, dry perimeter seal and one keyed service bracket
door_interface.release_gate: supplier freeze, structural interface calculation and all applicable door safety tests

fastener_families.installation_control: positive seating, released torque table, witness mark and visual captive-part check
fastener_families.nominal: M6 captive flanged screw into floating service-rail nut
prohibited_uses: seat or handhold primary load paths
fastener_families.release_authority: small-component standard plus accepted fastener batch and calibrated-tool procedure
fastener_families.retained_element: captive screw and retained sliding nut

fastener_families.installation_control: joint-specific load/preload calculation, released torque, locking feature and witness mark
fastener_families.nominal: M8 flanged bolt into floating nutplate or qualified blind-rivet nut
fastener_families.release_authority: released interface calculation and drawing plus accepted fastener batch
fastener_families.retained_element: captive/floating female thread with anti-rotation feature

fastener_families.installation_control: supplier grip-range gauge, closed-position indication and pull-check sampling
fastener_families.nominal: tool-operated captive quarter-turn stud and receptacle
fastener_families.release_authority: accepted supplier part and receptacle/grip schedule
fastener_families.retained_element: stud retained in removable panel; receptacle retained on rail adapter

fastener_families.installation_control: interface calculation, seal compression gauge, released torque and water-ingress test
fastener_families.nominal: M10 isolating flanged bolt into sealed floating nutplate
fastener_families.release_authority: released cassette interface drawing and calculation plus supplier installation manual
fastener_families.retained_element: sealed captive nutplate, isolation washer and replaceable environmental seal

lighting.replacement_rule: one module, two captive screws and one keyed plug; no field-cut strip or loose wire termination

principle: Use one datum rail and the smallest qualified fastener/connector family that matches load and service frequency; preserve supplier ownership of doors, glazing and safety-critical internal mechanisms.

service_rail.material: extruded aluminium rail with electrically isolated body attachments where required

window_interface.boundary: glass remains bonded to its supplier aluminium frame
window_interface.osr_interface: replaceable pressure frame, dry outer seal, drain path and captive secondary retention
window_interface.release_gate: glazing certificate, retention calculation, seal compression and water-ingress test
window_interface.replacement_rule: remove internal pressure frame and withdraw cassette; do not cut adhesive at the carbody
